sense: a meeting where you are asked questions for a job

pins.definition: A formal meeting or conversation in which someone is asked questions, such as for a job or by a journalist.
A formal meeting in which an employer asks an applicant questions to see if they are suitable for a job.
A formal meeting in which an applicant is asked questions for a job or study place.

situation: A nervous applicant sits across a desk answering questions from a manager in an office.
subject: the formal meeting with questions
brief: A young man sits upright on one side of a minimalist wooden office desk, clasping his hands together nervously while an interviewer on the other side holds an open folder and leans forward with a pen. Across the desk sits a single microphone and a printed application form, starkly lit by a desk lamp against a neutral wall.
prompt: A young man sits upright on one side of a minimalist wooden office desk, clasping his hands together nervously while an interviewer on the other side holds an open folder and leans forward with a pen. Across the desk sits a single microphone and a printed application form, starkly lit by a desk lamp against a neutral wall. a mid-century travel poster painted in gouache, rich opaque colour, confident simplified forms with real painted texture, strong diagonal composition. One square illustration. The scene is fully rendered and fully inhabited — no silhouettes, no flat icons, no diagram, no empty schematic space. A single subject dominates the frame and everything else is arranged around it. Absolutely no text anywhere in the image: no letters, words, numbers, captions, labels, signage, logos, watermarks or pseudo-text.
